acceptance.criterion_verbatim: PER K, on BOTH frames, each with its denominator: (i) fused with view 2 REAL; (ii) fused with view 2 PERMUTED -- C2's complement; (iii) fused with P; and (iv) view 1 fused with ITSELF (C1) -- ALSO PER K, at the same T, implementation, population, pair predicate and frame as (i)-(iii). C1 IS THE METHOD-INTRINSIC BASELINE AND K CHANGES SNF ITSELF (measured: real fusion 0.5510 at K=20, 0.5961 at K=100, c11d1ff734), so a C1 fixed at one K cannot bound method cost at another -- without (iv) per K, movement in (i)-(iii) is confounded between CHANGING METHOD EROSION and CHANGING SECOND-VIEW CONTRIBUTION. The comparison (iii) vs (ii) is the wave's whole question -- if P is flattened as hard as a permuted view, the flattening is METHOD-INTRINSIC; if P survives, it is firm-blindness of the input -- and it DISCRIMINATES ONLY when read against C1 AT THE SAME K.
acceptance.invocation: run_sweep.py -- run all four arms PER K, with C1 on each arm's OWN domain, 5 arm-runs x 4 K
acceptance.output_evidence: real 0.510-0.518 / permuted 0.492-0.500 / C1_bm 0.729-0.838 on the bm domain; P 0.985-1.000 vs C1_P 0.985-1.000 on P's domain. The (iii)-vs-(ii) comparison read against C1 at the same K attributes the flattening to view 2's CONTENT, not to SNF.
acceptance.denominator: 20 arm-runs; 8,596,731 bm pairs and 893,116 P pairs
acceptance.status_reason: cell L3W3-b8a2-3 status=WRITTEN, gate after-view-P receipt cited (verified against the carrier at build time, not asserted)

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: The EXACT-ZERO COUNT printed per K as an integer beside every AUC (sec 10a). Hard-K sparsification leaves entries outside each row's top-K at exactly 0.0 through diffusion -- 297,780 pairs (3.5%) tied at the bottom at K=20 -- and rank AUC is NOT tie-invariant. Tie mass moves WITH K, so without this integer a rising AUC cannot be told from fewer ties. One integer per run; its absence REFUSES the row.
acceptance.invocation: exact_zero_count() over the strict upper triangle -- one integer per run, counting EXACTLY-zero off-diagonal unordered pairs
acceptance.output_evidence: per K per arm; real 297,780 -> 0 -> 0 -> 0, C1_bm 3,399,312 -> 1,116,738 -> 52,912 -> 0. The K=20 real integer equals wave 2's cited 297,780 EXACTLY -- flagged, and recorded as corroboration of the IMPLEMENTATION (a combinatorial property with no float sensitivity) never of the RESULT (the AUC did not reproduce: 0.5104 vs 0.5358).
acceptance.status_reason: cell L3W3-b8a2-4 status=WRITTEN, gate after-view-P receipt cited (verified against the carrier at build time, not asserted)
